title: Oracle partners with Bloom for on-site fuel cell power at AI data centers

sources.quote: Bloom Energy is also addressing the surging power demands of artificial intelligence and cloud data centers through strategic agreements, including a $5.0 billion financing framework with Brookfield Asset Management and collaborations with Oracle and other hyperscale operators.

Forward-Looking Statements This Current Report on Form 8-K includes forward-looking statements, including statements regarding the anticipated benefits of the partnership between the Company and Oracle.

explain: Bloom Energy supplies on-site fuel cell power to Oracle's AI data centers; as part of the partnership Bloom agreed on October 28, 2025 to give Oracle a warrant for about 3.5 million Bloom shares. Contract value not disclosed. Plants: Bloom fuel cell installations at Oracle (OCI) data centers.
